We implement our model based on Fairseq (Ott et al., 2019) and PyTorch (Paszke et al., 2019). To optimize our model, we use the Adam (Kingma and Ba, 2015) optimizer with parameters (0.99, 0.98), while setting the clip norm to 10. We pretrain our model for 32K update steps on the ASR dataset and fine-tune it for 16K update steps on SpeechRE datasets. Meanwhile, we set the early stopping to 20 update steps during the fine-tuning stage and apply a learning rate of 1e-4 for both training stages, monitored by a tri-stage scheduler. We select the best checkpoint on the validation set for testing. All experiments are conducted on 4 NVIDIA Tesla-V100 GPUs.
